title: Reliability Fundamentals: Availability Math & Failure Domains — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces request routing across independent multi-zone failure domains, showing load balancing health checks isolating degraded instances.
routing_rationale: Active health check probing detects instance latency anomalies and routes production transactions exclusively to healthy compute domains.

nodes.detail: In-memory cache isolated within Zone A power domain.

nodes.label: Zone B Application Server

nodes.detail: Synchronized cache replica ready for instantaneous failover.

steps.title: Domain Partitioned Routing
steps.action: Traffic is distributed evenly across Zone A and Zone B failure domains.
steps.why_traversal: Isolates hardware blast radius: an outage in Zone A cannot affect Zone B.

steps.title: Low Latency Local Access
steps.action: Servers query intra-zone caches over Andromeda SDN at <1ms latency.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates cross-zone network charges while maintaining high throughput.

scenarios.label: Accidental Cross-Zone Traffic Leaks
scenarios.root_cause: Misconfiguration routed Zone A compute to query Zone B database for every request.
scenarios.diverted_path: Cross-zone latency added 2.5ms per query; network billing costs surged.
scenarios.blast_radius: Elevated latency and unnecessary inter-zone egress expenses.
scenarios.recovery: Configure client load balancer session affinity and zonal DNS endpoints.
